title: Naturally Crispy Uruguayan Salt Cod Empanadas
description: Savory empanadas filled with salt cod and crispy pastry, a nostalgic Uruguayan dish, served in a bento box for a fun meal on the go.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, cold butter, and eggs to make the pastry dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flaked salt cod, chopped onion, parsley, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the salt cod mixture onto the center of each pastry circle.
Fold the pastry in half to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of olive oil.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the empanadas in a bento box for a fun and easy meal.
